headline: Reliance's new generation is ready! Children's abilities will be proven with Jio's $106 billion mega IPO; Akash and Isha are leading the charge | business biz jio platforms ipo mukesh ambani children eye largest rs 30000 crore ipo of india
summary: Reliance is preparing an IPO for its telecom unit Jio Platforms, which the headline values at $106 billion. Mukesh Ambani's children are reported to be leading the effort.
why: Reliance Industries is one of India's most valuable conglomerates, spanning oil refining, petrochemicals, retail and telecommunications through Jio.
